title: Xiaomi Mitu Children's Learning Watch 4Pro launched with 8 MP 'T-LENS ultra-fast focus' camera
detail: Gizmochina: Mitu (Mi Bunny) Children's Learning Watch 4Pro launched at 1,299 yuan; front 5 MP f/2.4 82°; side '8-megapixel zoom camera ... f/2.2 aperture and 84.9-degree field-of-view with T-LENS ultra-fast focus'. First commercial poLight TLens product.

title: Xiaomi Mi MIX Fold ships NEXTLENS liquid lens in telephoto/macro camera
detail: Nextlens via gophotonics: 'first ever usage of its novel liquid lens element in a flagship phone'; Xiaomi launch 'today' per Android Central (date approx. from article).

title: 36Kr: Xiaomi partnering with ODM Goertek on AI glasses; Lei Jun expects >300,000 units
detail: Road to VR citing 36Kr: Xiaomi partnering with ODM Goertek on AI glasses benchmarked against Ray-Ban Meta; launch expected Q2 2025; Lei Jun reportedly expects more than 300,000 units.

title: Xiaomi teases AI Glasses as 'next-generation personal smart device' for next-day launch
detail: Xiaomi officially teased its AI Glasses for launch the following day, calling them a 'next-generation personal smart device'.

title: Xiaomi AI Glasses launched: 12 MP Sony IMX681, Snapdragon AR1, from 1,999 yuan
detail: Launched at the 'Human x Car x Home' event: 12 MP Sony IMX681, f/2.2, 105° FOV, EIS, 4032×3024 stills, 2K/30 fps video (45-min cap); Snapdragon AR1 + BES2700; 263 mAh / 8.6 h; 40 g; 1,999 yuan base, 2,699 electrochromic, 2,999 colour electrochromic; China only

title: IT Home: Xiaomi AI Glasses gen 2 'R&D complete' but paused, may slip to Q4 2026/2027 (denied)
detail: IT Home citing XR Vision: 2nd-gen AI glasses 'R&D complete' but Lu Weibing 'pressed the pause button' over appearance; launch may slip to Q4 2026 or 2027. Xiaomi called the report 'false ... constitutes rumors'. Same piece: gen-1 held 28% of China smart-glasse
